current_data_validation.manual_preview_note: Primary-agent inspection confirmed one current sample curve, one native Origin column-stick reference card, current labels, bold visible axis titles, and no raster overlays or stale template labels.

variable_structure_support.origin_visual_run_scope: one current sample plus one supplied reference card, limited per user request to control test scale
variable_structure_support.source_layout: one shared two_theta_deg X column, one or more unique sample Y columns, and exactly one final reference-card Y column
semantic_guards: every current sample column is plotted in source order
sample headers are nonempty and unique
exactly one reference-card header is required
the reference-card column must be the final Y column
every series has contiguous paired finite X/Y rows
variable_structure_support.native_origin_construction: one clean Origin layer with native sample line plots and one native column-stick reference-card plot
variable_structure_support.style_cycle: reviewed XRD sample color sequence with a native Wine reference-card column style

acceptance_note: XRD OTH+JSON is accepted as the detached adaptive route for current shared-X sample patterns with one supplied reference card. It uses only native Origin workbooks, plots, labels, OPJU save/reopen, and native export. The independently verified fixed OTPU remains the exact four-sample-plus-card zero-pixel route; this adaptive current-data route deliberately makes no one-to-one pixel claim.
